memories.content: Donald Trump is the Republican Party's presidential nominee. He has been invited to the Al Smith Memorial Foundation Dinner on October 20, 2016. He has not yet confirmed attendance.

The Al Smith Memorial Foundation Dinner is a charitable event scheduled for October 20, 2016 in New York City. It is traditional for major-party presidential nominees to attend and deliver humorous speeches. Both nominees have been invited but have not yet publicly confirmed whether they will attend in person.
